title: Silybum marianum tincture for medicinal use
intro: Silybum marianum tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the seeds of the milk thistle plant, known for its potent liver-protecting properties. This preparation is widely used in herbalism to support liver function and detoxification, particularly in cases of liver damage or disease. It is believed to contain silymarin, a group of antioxidants that help repair and protect liver cells. Herbalists often recommend it for conditions such as hepatitis, cirrhosis, and toxic liver injury. Additionally, it may aid in reducing inflammation and promoting overall digestive health.
